name: cmx-enterprise-portal
description: CMX 系列项目根（workspaces）。数据与表格组件统一在 packages/cmx-data-comp，由 CMXHTMLDesigner、CMXPortalManager 等子项目复用。

scripts.test: npm test -w cmx-data-comp && npm test -w cmx-html-designer
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w cmx-data-comp && npm run lint -w cmx-portal-manager
scripts.build:portal: npm run build -w cmx-ui5-runtime && npm run build -w cmx-portal-manager
scripts.build:html: npm run build -w cmx-ui5-runtime && npm run build -w cmx-html-designer
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:runtime && npm run build -w cmx-portal-manager && npm run build -w cmx-html-designer
